pr_comments:
This doesn't seem to fix the issue, only one edge case:

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/37378746/92fa1e91-9803-42a6-becf-0c39cef640f1)

If the line doesn't start with `#` (so basically all inline comments), the issue at hand is still present:

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/37378746/3c78092a-02e9-4ec1-9366-071fadbe8510)
Please take a look at my comment in #53364 the fix is quite a lot more involved then it first seems.
Yes, the brace highlight should not exist in `TextEdit` and it needs to be moved to `CodeEdit`.

issue_context.title: Brace mismatch highlight appears for comments as well
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.2.beta1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.2.beta1

### Issue description

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/61206149/8c574cde-313d-442f-b301-b1cce6d3a8fa)
![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/61206149/b85636a8-d64d-4d06-99bc-11e01ab55c65)

for some reason, the bracket is only highlighted if the caret is next to the bracket

### Steps to reproduce

1 - Make a comment
2 - End it with ) and dont include an opening bracket (
3 - Put your caret next to it

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A: too trivial, just open any project and make a comment
comments:
> for some reason, the bracket is only highlighted if the caret is next to the bracket

This is done by design for brace mismatch highlighting, but it shouldn't happen within comments.
what happens now that a pull request has been opened to fix the issue? should this issue get closed or what
Issues are closed when/if the pull request is merged. So for now it should stay open.
Going to close as a duplicate of #53332, and it's not an easy fix see comment in #53364

review_comments: I believe GDScript doesn't use `//` for comments.

```suggestion
									String line_data = get_line(line).strip_edges(true, false);
```
Use `snake_case`, and strip whitespace to fix the mentioned issue
